sentences: An interactive version that contains embedded hyperlinks to the Fitness Browser (20) can be accessed via this link: https://ppnitrogentsne.lbl.gov.

By clicking the highlighted centroid (right), the user is redirected to the Fitness Browser (https://fit.genomics.lbl.gov) (20), where the fitness data for all significant genes in the condition cluster is shown.
We refer to the Fitness Browser (https://fit.genomics.lbl.gov) and the interactive t-SNE visualization (Fig.
All experiments were conducted in biological duplicate, and all fitness data are publicly available at http://fit.genomics.lbl.gov.
Sequencing data (fastq files) were deposited at the NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) with accession number SRP385031.
Perl and Python scripts used for fitness calculations and to generate heatmaps, Venn diagrams, and 2D fitness score graphs are accessible from https://github.com/beckham-lab/RB-TnSeq.git.
